title: Tell Pro customers about the price change
brief: Write the email that tells existing Pro customers about the price change. Everything you need is in notes/ in the project folder. It goes to customers as it is, so it must be right: at most 250 words, plain, no marketing language, and it must say what changes, when, what it means for them, and what they can do.
stands_for: a document written from sources that disagree
